## Summary & Core Identity
Sahil Gangurde (known online as **lostmartian**) is a Freelance AI and Backend Systems Engineer and startup founder. He specializes in:
- High-throughput deterministic backend engines (Go, Python, Polars)
- Autonomous AI agent trajectory evaluation and regression testing
- GraphRAG platforms (Neo4j, Google Gemini, LangGraph)
- Scale-elastic, zero-trust cloud architecture (AWS Batch, Step Functions, Aurora, ECS)
